title: Cursed Angel: Time Paradox
description:
• RTS gameplay

    

• Super hero with speed of light

KEY FEATURES• Become a super hero, dragon or command legendary legions to kill demons

• Use the Mask Of Time to freeze time or travel through time.

• 70+ heroes and legions to unlock.

• More than 100 choices to decide your fate.

• Find a genie to grant you a wish.

• Open world with procedurally-generated content, as well as 9 legend castles to discover and conquer.

• Raid, capture, and upgrade castles.

• Hundreds of skills and items to unlock.

• Many side things to do: fishing, finding treasure, dancing, flirting, training weapons and magic...
description_short: In Cursed Angel: Time Paradox, players engage in a captivating blend of time travel, real-time strategy, and action RPG elements. Take control of a heroic character capable of harnessing the speed of light, manipulating time, and seamlessly transitioning between different timelines.
